title: The Lord Is My Shepherd
story:
A shepherd once cared for a small flock of sheep near the hills.

Every morning, he led them to places where they could find fresh grass and clean water.

When the weather became hot, he guided them to a place of shade.

When danger appeared, he stayed close and protected them.

The sheep did not need to know where they would go next or how they would find everything they needed.

They simply followed the shepherd because they trusted him.

One evening, a young lamb wandered away from the flock.

The shepherd noticed immediately and went looking for it.

When he found the lamb, he carried it safely back to the flock.

The lamb was completely dependent on its shepherd, and the shepherd willingly cared for it.

Psalm 23 begins with a beautiful declaration: "The Lord is my shepherd."

David understood that God was not distant from him. God was personally caring for him, guiding him, protecting him, and providing what he needed.

We often worry about whether we will have enough for tomorrow.

We may worry about money, work, family, health, or the future.

But this verse reminds us that when the Lord is our Shepherd, we are not alone.

A shepherd knows what his sheep need and leads them to the right places at the right time.

In the same way, God knows our needs better than we do.

He may not give us everything we want, but He faithfully provides what is truly necessary according to His wisdom.

Being able to say, "The Lord is my shepherd," means choosing to trust His care instead of being controlled by fear about what we do not have.

Today, bring your needs and worries to God.

Follow His guidance one step at a time and trust Him to provide what you need.

You belong to a Shepherd who knows you, cares for you, and will never abandon you.
life_lesson: When the Lord is your Shepherd, you can trust Him to guide, protect, and provide for you. You do not need to live in fear of what tomorrow may bring.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for being my Shepherd and for caring for every part of my life.

Help me trust You when I worry about my needs and my future.

Guide me toward the right decisions and lead me in the paths that are pleasing to You.

Provide what I truly need and give me wisdom to be thankful for what You have already given me.

When I feel uncertain, remind me that I am not walking alone.

Protect me from choices that could lead me away from You and help me follow Your voice.

Teach me to be content with Your provision instead of constantly worrying about what I do not have.

When I feel lost or afraid, draw me close to You and remind me of Your faithful care.

Thank You for knowing me, loving me, guiding me, and never abandoning me.

I place my needs and my future into Your hands today.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What need or worry are you carrying today that you need to place in God's hands?

Are you trusting God to provide, or are you allowing fear about the future to control you?

What is one way you can follow God's guidance more closely today?
verse: The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing.
